# Synthetic HEIF fixtures

These two tiny red/blue fixtures are copied unchanged from pillow-heif v1.8.1.
They contain stereo entity groups; entity_groups.heic deliberately stores the
halves in a different order and includes an invalid additional group.

Source: https://github.com/bigcat88/pillow_heif/tree/v1.8.1/tests/images
License: BSD-3-Clause; the upstream notice is retained in LICENSE.txt.
SHA-256 and original paths: docs/IMAGE_FORMATS_1.1.md.
The actual Spatial Photo and camera-orientation fixture are downloaded only by
the separate development/package probe and are not redistributed here.
